usage: vibe [-h] [--version] {upgrade,wikify,kits} ...

Install and manage portable engineering kits.

positional arguments:
  {upgrade,wikify,kits}
    upgrade             Self-upgrade the vibe CLI to the latest version
    wikify              Maintain a verified repo wiki in docs/wiki
    kits                List and manage kits

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version, -V         show program's version number and exit
